questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Botanically, a pumpkin is a…
questions.q_zh: 从植物学上讲，南瓜属于……
questions.explain_en: Pumpkins grow from flowers and hold seeds, so they are fruits.
questions.explain_zh: 南瓜由花发育而来、有种子，所以是果实。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: What do plants need for photosynthesis?
questions.q_zh: 植物进行光合作用需要什么？
questions.explain_en: Plants use sunlight, water and CO₂ to make sugar and give off oxygen.
questions.explain_zh: 植物用阳光、水和二氧化碳制造糖分，放出氧气。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which gas do plants give off during photosynthesis?
questions.q_zh: 光合作用时植物放出哪种气体？
questions.explain_en: Plants release oxygen, which we breathe.
questions.explain_zh: 植物放出氧气，正是我们呼吸需要的。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which part of the plant takes in water from the soil?
questions.q_zh: 植物的哪个部分从土里吸水？
questions.explain_en: Roots soak up water and nutrients.

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Bees visiting pumpkin flowers help the plant by…
questions.q_zh: 蜜蜂飞到南瓜花上能帮植物……
questions.explain_en: Bees carry pollen between flowers so pumpkins can form.
questions.explain_zh: 蜜蜂在花之间传粉，南瓜才能结出来。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: You push a hay bale and it slides. What made it move?
questions.q_zh: 你推干草垛，它滑动了，是什么让它动？
questions.explain_en: Objects start moving when an unbalanced force acts on them.
questions.explain_zh: 物体受到不平衡的力才会开始运动。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Why does a jumping {name} always come back down?
questions.q_zh: {name} 跳起来为什么总会落回地面？
questions.explain_en: Earth's gravity pulls everything toward its centre.
questions.explain_zh: 地球的重力把一切往地心拉。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Running on rough dirt is easier to stop than on ice because of more…
questions.q_zh: 在粗糙土路上比在冰上更容易停下，因为……更大
questions.explain_en: Rough surfaces create more friction, which slows you down.
questions.explain_zh: 粗糙表面摩擦力大，能让你减速。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: A heavy pumpkin and a light pumpkin are pushed with the same force. Which speeds up more?
questions.q_zh: 用同样大的力推一个重南瓜和一个轻南瓜，哪个加速更快？
questions.explain_en: The same force accelerates a smaller mass more (Newton's second law).
questions.explain_zh: 同样的力，质量越小加速越快（牛顿第二定律）。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which is a mixture you can separate with a sieve?
questions.q_zh: 下面哪种混合物能用筛子分开？
questions.explain_en: Pebbles stay in the sieve while sand falls through.
questions.explain_zh: 石子留在筛子里，沙子漏下去。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: How can you get salt back from salt water?
questions.q_zh: 怎样从盐水里把盐取回来？
questions.explain_en: When water evaporates, the salt is left behind.
questions.explain_zh: 水蒸发后，盐就留下来了。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which tool separates iron nails from sawdust?
questions.q_zh: 哪种工具能把铁钉从木屑里分出来？
questions.explain_en: Iron is magnetic; sawdust is not.
questions.explain_zh: 铁会被磁铁吸住，木屑不会。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Sugar stirred into water seems to disappear. This mixture is called a…
questions.q_zh: 糖搅进水里好像不见了，这种混合物叫……
questions.explain_en: The sugar dissolves evenly, making a solution.

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.q_zh: 哪颗行星离太阳最近？
questions.explain_en: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun.

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which is the largest planet in our solar system?
questions.q_zh: 太阳系最大的行星是哪颗？
questions.explain_en: Jupiter is bigger than all the other planets combined.
questions.explain_zh: 木星比其他行星加起来还大。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: How many planets are in our solar system?
questions.q_zh: 太阳系有几颗行星？
questions.explain_en: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune.
questions.explain_zh: 水金地火木土天海，一共 8 颗。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Why do we have day and night?
questions.q_zh: 为什么会有白天和黑夜？
questions.explain_en: Earth rotates once about every 24 hours.
questions.explain_zh: 地球大约每 24 小时自转一圈。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: How long does Earth take to go around the Sun once?
questions.q_zh: 地球绕太阳转一圈要多久？
questions.explain_en: One trip around the Sun is one year.

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which body system carries oxygen around your body?
questions.q_zh: 哪个身体系统把氧气送到全身？
questions.explain_en: The heart pumps blood that carries oxygen.
questions.explain_zh: 心脏泵出的血液把氧气带到全身。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which organ do you use to breathe in air?
questions.q_zh: 你用哪个器官吸进空气？
questions.explain_en: Lungs take in oxygen and let out carbon dioxide.
questions.explain_zh: 肺吸入氧气，呼出二氧化碳。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which body system helps you move your legs to run?
questions.q_zh: 哪个身体系统让你的腿动起来跑步？
questions.explain_en: Muscles pull on bones to make you move.
questions.explain_zh: 肌肉拉动骨头，让你动起来。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Which body system sends messages from your brain to your feet?
questions.q_zh: 哪个系统把大脑的指令传到脚上？
questions.explain_en: Nerves carry signals from the brain to the body.
questions.explain_zh: 神经把大脑的信号传遍全身。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Where does digestion of your lunch mostly finish?
questions.q_zh: 午饭的消化主要在哪里完成？
questions.explain_en: Most nutrients are absorbed in the small intestine.
questions.explain_zh: 大部分营养在小肠被吸收。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Some tiny animals called tardigrades can survive in…
questions.q_zh: 一种叫水熊虫的小动物能在哪里活下来？
questions.explain_en: Tardigrades are famous for surviving extreme environments.
questions.explain_zh: 水熊虫以能在极端环境中生存而闻名。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: Corn plants grow tall to reach more…
questions.q_zh: 玉米长得很高，是为了得到更多……
questions.explain_zh: 阳光越多，光合作用越多。

questions.subject: farm
questions.q_en: Corn (maize) was first grown by people in…
questions.q_zh: 玉米最早是在哪里被人类种植的？
questions.explain_en: Indigenous peoples in Mexico domesticated corn thousands of years ago.
questions.explain_zh: 几千年前墨西哥原住民培育了玉米。

questions.subject: farm
questions.q_en: The silky threads on top of an ear of corn are called…
questions.q_zh: 玉米棒顶上那一缕缕的丝叫……
questions.explain_en: Each silk thread connects to one kernel.
questions.explain_zh: 每根玉米须连着一粒玉米粒。

questions.subject: farm
questions.q_en: In what season are pumpkins usually harvested in BC?
questions.q_zh: BC 省的南瓜通常在哪个季节收获？
questions.explain_en: Pumpkins ripen in September and October.
